title: Privacy policy
intro: What personal information we collect, why, and what your rights are.
body:
*Last updated: [date]*

## Who we are

This website is run by {{trading_name}}, trading as Out and About Books, {{business_address}}. We are the controller of the personal information described here. You can contact us about privacy at {{contact_email}}.

[Most UK businesses that handle personal information must pay the data protection fee to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). Check at ico.org.uk whether you need to, and add your ICO registration number here if you do.]

## What we collect and why

**When you contact us.** If you use our contact form or email us, we receive your name, email address and message. We use them to reply to you. Our lawful basis is our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

**When you sign up to our newsletter.** We collect your email address and use it to send you news about our books. Our lawful basis is your consent, and you can withdraw it at any time by using the unsubscribe link in any email or by contacting us.

**We don't take payments.** You can't buy anything on this website itself, so we don't collect payment or delivery details. When you buy from Amazon or another shop, that shop collects them under its own privacy policy.

## Who we share it with

We use a small number of service providers to run this website, and they process personal information on our behalf:

- **[Your web host, e.g. IONOS]** hosts this website and our email. Messages and newsletter sign-ups sent through our forms are emailed to us through its servers.
- [Add your email newsletter provider here if you use one, for example MailerLite or Buttondown.]

If any of these providers store information outside the UK, the transfer is protected by the UK's adequacy regulations or by contractual safeguards approved under UK law.

We don't sell your personal information and we don't use it for advertising.

If you click a link to Amazon or another retailer, that retailer's own privacy policy applies to anything you do on its website.

## How long we keep it

We keep enquiries for up to [e.g. two years], and newsletter sign-ups until you unsubscribe.

## Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, and to ask us to correct it, delete it, or stop or limit how we use it. To make a request, email {{contact_email}}. If you're unhappy with how we've handled your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.

---
